#### How many pairs?

Telling all ten digits apart one pair at a time,
as @exr-zero-or-one and @exr-three-or-eight did,
takes a [feature](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/course-overview.html#def-feature) for every pair of digits.
How many pairs of digits are there?

:::
